items.title: 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities

source_refs.note: Topic 33.4, printed pages 251-252 (PDF 254-255), with Quick Check 33.4.

blocks.text: Human activities are a major cause of water pollution across the globe. As populations grow and industries expand, more waste and pollutants are introduced into water bodies. Improper waste management and lack of environmental regulations often lead to contaminants reaching rivers, lakes, and oceans.
